text:
sam: Hey folks  accepted to attend a 10-week startup accelerator in Singapore (2026-08-02 -> 2026-10-10). I'm still employed at Redwood and will be working remotely for us while attending the program. Questions: do I need to declare as temporary homebase? Will WFH stipend continue? Can Redwood ship a standing desk (approx $450) and a monitor? Also the accelerator offers a small honorarium for demo day  does that impact payroll/tax? Lastly, worried the accelerator events (demos, meetups) might create nexus risk for Redwood if I'm representing the company there.
people-ops: Congrats @sam! Short answers: 1) yes submit the Homebase Change form (https://redwood.company/forms/homebase) and mark "program/accelerator" as purpose, 2) stipend typically continues and is prorated for partial months, 3) equipment shipping allowed under temporary equipment cap (monitor/desk) but desks sometimes need customs paperwork; open `#it-ship`, 4) honorarium is personal income and could have tax/reporting implications  legal/tax will advise.
tax-eng: Heads-up: accelerator + public demos increases nexus risk because of potential client interactions and public representation. Key factors: are you signing any agreements on Redwood's behalf? Are you using Redwood branding or pitching product features? We'll run a nexus review with external counsel once the form is in and depending on activities we may recommend routing via EOR or limiting company representation.
legal: Clarifying honorarium: if the payment is to you personally for participation, it's not Redwood payroll. But if you accept it appearing as Redwood-related compensation (e.g., for a workshop hosted by Redwood), we need to review. Please do not sign contracts or accept payments in Redwood's name without prior sign-off.
hr-benefits: Note on benefits: US medical remains primary while on USD payroll; routine care overseas not covered. If you accept the honorarium, you may have personal tax reporting obligations. We'll also confirm whether the standing desk falls under equipment (IT) or relocation (if you ship household goods).
payroll-ops: If you stay on USD payroll we usually treat this as temporary remote. Honorarium paid to you directly may require you to declare it and we can provide a proof of employment letter if needed for local authorities. If tax partner recommends EOR for SG we will notify you.
it-ship: For desk+monitor: open `#it-ship` ticket with SKUs and SG delivery address. Temporary equipment cap is $1,500. We'll need commercial invoice for customs and local duties may apply. If you want Redwood to pre-pay vendor, mark that in the ticket.
people-ops-bot: Policy note: "Temporary Remote + Public Events (accelerators, conferences)" guidance added: https://redwood.company/policies/temp-remote-public-events. Checklist: homebase form, passport, event invite, receipts, avoid signing agreements.
sam: Thanks all  submitted Homebase Change form and uploaded event invite. I'll avoid signing or accepting payments in Redwood's name. Honorarium will be paid to me personally. Opened `#it-ship` ticket for desk+monitor (ticket-1188). Appreciate the quick guidance! :rocket:
